body: Adversarial review round 8 (codex): when the retire ticket dropped the tickets.json exclusion from staging, nothing rejects a legacy .adlc/tickets.json that a builder creates or force-adds, and an empty ticket scope skips the scope check, so the candidate can advance main with both stores present and the next run fails closed. Fix in lib/scheduler.mjs verifyScopeAndAntiNoOp: any changed path (including rename/copy src and dest, and deletions) equal to .adlc/tickets.json is rejected with kind scope_violation and a LEGACY_TICKET_STORE message, before the rail and scope checks, independent of ticket scope. Add regression tests in test/git-sandbox-candidate-isolation.test.mjs (or the nearest verifyScopeAndAntiNoOp suite): a candidate adding .adlc/tickets.json with an empty scope and with a matching broad scope is rejected, an ordinary change still passes. Acceptance: npm test green; new tests fail without the fix; rails-guard clean for lib/lock.mjs and lib/gates.mjs.
title: Reject a builder-introduced legacy .adlc/tickets.json at candidate validation
